$comment: Rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. schema/semantic_validate.py reads severity, exceptions and parameters from THIS file at runtime, and implements exactly these rule ids (verify_all.py checks id parity both ways), so prose and enforcement cannot silently diverge. Dividers are 'transparent' for category/motion adjacency rules.

rules.description: PageSpec.template must exist in templates/templates.json.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: source-reproduction: route must be one of the template's real routes. new-page: route must match newPageRoutePattern and must not be a real route.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: nodes[] must be an in-order match of the DECLARED template's slot list: each node consumes one slot with the same (section, variant); optional slots may be skipped; required slots may not.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: A (section, variant) whose contract sets constraints.onePerPage may appear at most once.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: shell.navbar is node 0.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: shell.footer is the last node.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: hero.api-search is node 1, directly after the navbar.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: cta.final is the last non-divider node before shell.footer.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: Two shell.lines-divider nodes may never be adjacent with nothing between them (e.g. after removing an optional section, remove one of its dividers too).
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: At most one HERO-category node. No hero-less template exists (the only template requires a hero), so no exception is needed.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: Every pair of consecutive non-divider nodes must have exactly one base divider between them, EXCEPT the named pairs, which must be directly adjacent with no divider (navbar->hero, hero->logo-grid, problem->solution: the real page has no divider there).
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: narrative.problem and narrative.solution appear together, problem immediately followed by solution (Solution reuses Problem's layout and continues its band), or neither appears.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: Consecutive non-divider nodes should not share a category, except the named real adjacencies.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: Two consecutive non-divider nodes should not both run continuously looping motion (the real page never places them adjacently).
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: Every node carries a non-empty motion.reducedMotionFallback (prescriptive policy; the source has none).

rules.description: motion.patterns must be a subset of the section contract's motion.allowedPatterns; 'none' cannot be combined with other patterns.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).

rules.description: assetRole must be in the closed allowlist and allowed for that field; must-reuse-exact => assetRef in knownAssets; may-generate-new => knownAssets or 'generate:' (new-page only); must-not-fabricate => knownAssets on source-reproduction, 'placeholder:' on new-page.
rules.templateCheck: Checked against templates.json template.home-landing (24-slot full sequence and the minimal backbone) at write time and on every verify_all.py run (section 11).
